title: Engine startup phases from the server container's log (docker compose logs --timestamps)

inputs.server_s<N>.log: the run folder: scripts/compose_stack.py down() saves the server service's log before compose down, one file per server start N; each line '<service>  | <UTC timestamp, ns> <text>'

_doc: engines: one entry per engine. detect: a regex that only that engine's log matches. phases: in order; each phase starts at the first line after the previous phase's start that matches its 'from' regex (null: the log's first line) and ends where the next phase starts; the last one ends at 'end'. health: the name of the phase from 'end' to the container's first health status (adapters/docker.py), the wait for the healthcheck. A marker that is missing stops the phases there (counted). Names say what the engine does in that stretch, from its own log lines.

phases.phase: CUDA graphs, memory profile, KV cache
